summary: Replay the population-density part of the source merge_neutral_populations over an explicit (6,nx,ny,nz) beam-grid state: per-cell, per-level addition with the target owning the written result, the source observed and never modified, and no cross-cell mixing.

identity.relation: For every cell (i,j,k) and level l: target_population_density_after[l,i,j,k] = target_population_density_before[l,i,j,k] + source_population_density[l,i,j,k]; source_population_density_after = source_population_density (never written); density_contribution = source_population_density; density_contribution_sum = sum over all levels and cells; cell_shape = (nx,ny,nz) and cell_count = nx*ny*nz reported.
identity.direction: target (6,nx,ny,nz) density grid + source (6,nx,ny,nz) density grid -> target/source before and after grids, source contribution grid and total, cell shape and cell count
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM 中性库种群网格合并 operator (framework node N3 neutral_population_transport; source anchor src/fidasim.f90:10484-10498 merge_neutral_populations density half, pop1%dens = pop1%dens + pop2%dens at :10493). The array form of the single-cell relation neutral-population-density-merge: shape, six-level order and source ownership are preserved and no normalization, clipping or cross-cell mixing occurs. Signed finite source components are added as-is; the caller owns the physical interpretation.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with one registered hardening
identity.geometry: one explicit Cartesian beam-grid state of caller-declared positive cell dimensions (nx,ny,nz >= 1)
identity.coordinates: densities in the caller's source density units (the operator performs no unit conversion); level axis first, then x, y, z cells
identity.boundary: both inputs finite (6,nx,ny,nz) real grids with identical shapes and positive cell dimensions; no reservoir state, ind2sub scheduling, MPI allreduce, rank ownership, HDF5 or N1->N3 handoff
assumptions: Both grids describe the same beam grid and level convention (e.g. two NDMC-produced six-level population grids for different marker batches).
The caller owns any downstream physical interpretation of merged negative components.

inputs.name: target_population_density
inputs.description: The written target six-level density grid before the merge.
inputs.constraints: Finite, level axis exactly 6, positive cell dimensions; boolean entries rejected (registered hardening).

inputs.name: source_population_density
inputs.description: The observed source six-level density grid added into the target.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the target; finite; finite negative values accepted without truncation; boolean entries rejected (registered hardening).

outputs.name: target_population_density_before
outputs.constraints: Elementwise equal to the input target grid.

outputs.name: source_population_density_before
outputs.constraints: Elementwise equal to the input source grid.

outputs.name: target_population_density_after
outputs.constraints: Elementwise equal to target + source and finite.

outputs.name: source_population_density_after
outputs.description: The post-merge source grid: never written.
outputs.constraints: Elementwise equal to the input source grid.

outputs.name: density_contribution
outputs.description: The source contribution grid of this merge.
outputs.constraints: Elementwise equal to the input source grid.

outputs.name: density_contribution_sum
outputs.description: The total source contribution over all levels and cells.
outputs.constraints: Finite and equal to the contribution-grid sum.

outputs.name: cell_shape
outputs.constraints: Equal to the input grid's cell dimensions.

outputs.name: cell_count
outputs.description: The number of merged cells nx*ny*nz.

preconditions: Both grids describe the same beam grid and level convention.
supported: One explicit beam-grid population merge with per-cell ownership bookkeeping.
excluded: Reservoir payload ownership, ind2sub iteration scheduling, MPI allreduce, rank ownership, HDF5 output, N1->N3 handoff and whole-program replay.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when either input is not numeric, not a finite (6,nx,ny,nz) grid, has a zero or negative cell dimension, carries boolean entries (registered hardening), or when the two grids have different shapes.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Not applicable; the addition of finite grids is finite for finite inputs.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a failed call leaves the caller's arrays untouched (the merge works on internal copies).

example.description: The saved package's per-cell addition over a (6,4,1,1) state with signed source values.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import merge_neutral_population_cells
target = np.arange(24.0).reshape(6, 4, 1, 1)
source = np.full((6, 4, 1, 1), -0.25)
result = merge_neutral_population_cells(
    target_population_density=target, source_population_density=source)
assert np.array_equal(result['target_population_density_after'], target + source)
assert np.array_equal(result['source_population_density_after'], source)
assert result['cell_shape'] == [4, 1, 1] and result['cell_count'] == 4
assert np.isclose(result['density_contribution_sum'], -6.0)
try:
    merge_neutral_population_cells(
        target_population_density=np.ones((6, 4, 1, 1)),
        source_population_density=np.ones((6, 3, 1, 1)))
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('a shape mismatch must be rejected')
example.expected: The saved probes reproduce; the shape mismatch raises ValueError.
